how: Each CLI started in a 120x40 pty (@lydell/node-pty, @xterm/headless) with Hive's session environment (TERM_PROGRAM=Hive, COLORTERM=truecolor, an allowlisted base, no WT_SESSION), once without TERM and once with TERM=xterm-256color; nothing sent. Claude Code in the signed-in test home, Codex in its test home (trust given per launch), Copilot offline in a new COPILOT_HOME (COPILOT_MODEL=gpt-4.1). Screens compared row by row; colours are the SGR codes it drew, counted.

claude-code 2.1.312.screen: one row differs: the trust question's pointer, '>' without TERM, '❯' with it (trust-noterm-/trust-term-claude-2.1.312.txt); its input box's mark likewise (input-ascii-claude-2.1.312.txt, input-claude-2.1.312.txt, HI-1979)

copilot 1.0.105.screen: identical without and with TERM (its prompt already draws ❯ either way)
